title: Tamsin and the Uniform
author: Beatrix Hartwell
blurb: Jonah Montrose, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
